svg.title: A separate piece of evidence for each claim
svg.desc: A size marking does not prove the generation. A moving seat does not demonstrate all adjustments. A new part does not document every component.

g.text: Keep the evidence with its claim
Record in the size field; check generation separately.
Record that movement; check other controls separately.
Record that part; ask what else was changed.
An unanswered field stays unresolved. Do not invent a pass score.
